data.long_meaning: Lucivan is derived from the Latin name Lucius, which means 'man from Lucania'. Lucania was a region in ancient Italy, so Lucivan would have originally been a Roman name. In Christian tradition, Saint Lucian of Syracuse is a prominent figure with this name. The name Lucivan carries the meaning “Man from Lucania” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Latin. Parents who choose Lucivan usually hope their child will grow to embody man from lucania and live with faith, good character and purpose.
